description: List spaces (the containers for posts — e.g. discussions, Q&A, articles) in the community, with pagination. Optionally filter by name (`query`), order (`orderBy`, a SpaceListOrderByEnum value), and reverse the order. Returns edges[].node plus pageInfo and totalCount. Bettermode GraphQL query: spaces.

limit.description: Max number of spaces to return (1..100, default 10).

offset.description: Number of spaces to skip (offset-based pagination).

query.description: Filter to spaces matching this name/search term.

name: bettermode_list_spaces
title: List spaces
